minor.issue: Admin auto-apply path writes product stock without recording a stock_movement audit row — journal (Mouvements tab) will miss admin-driven adjustments. Managers' approved requests ARE journaled via /decide approve. Consider inserting a stock_movements doc in the admin auto-apply branch for parity.

Blind-receive persists `qty_counted` back onto each line item BEFORE validation — if the receiver re-opens the PO after blind-receive but before admin validates, the ordered qty is overwritten. Store counted qty in `reception.counts` only; keep item.qty = ordered until validate-gaps.

Server hides qty_expected for open inventories (good) — but counted_by/updated_at are still copied back which could leak expected inferred values via `qty_counted` saved earlier. Confirm anti-peek on subsequent GETs after partial counts.

issues: Email + password inputs lack data-testid / name / id / placeholder → unreliable for automated testing. Add data-testid='login-email' / 'login-password' / 'login-submit'.

Hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' triggered by the visual-editor instrumentation (x-source-* span inside option in PeriodSelector.jsx and CreateOnFlySelect.jsx). Dev-only warning but noisy — wrap option children in a bare string, not <span>.

Do NOT persist qty_counted onto PO item.qty inside /blind-receive — keep it on reception.counts until /validate-gaps commits.
Add data-testid to login email/password/submit (currently anonymous inputs break reliable e2e).
Fix React hydration warning: PeriodSelector option label + CreateOnFlySelect __add__ option both have a <span> child inside <option> (from visual-editor instrumentation).
